“If anything happens, I'm right behind you.”

Jason Duval is a character due to appear as one of the protagonists in Grand Theft Auto VI. 

Random fact: he loves shake it off by taylor swift

“"Jason wants an easy life, but things just keep getting harder."
Jason grew up around grifters and crooks. After a stint in the Army trying to shake off his troubled teens, he found himself in the Keys doing what he knows best, working for local drug runners. It might be time to try something new.

"Another day in paradise, right?"
Meeting Lucia could be the best or worst thing to ever happen to him. Jason knows how he'd like it to turn out but right now, it's hard to tell.”

Jason is a former Army serviceman who works for local drug runners in the Leonida Keys. He later becomes partners with Lucia Caminos, with the pair becoming involved in a criminal conspiracy spanning Leonida.

Brian Heder, a veteran of the Keys' drug trade, allows Jason to live rent-free at one of his properties in Key Lento in exchange for helping with local shakedowns.

Relationships

Lucia Caminos

Jason is partners with Lucia Caminos. Rockstar Games describes Lucia as the "engine" of their partnership and Jason as the "brake", with the two characters complementing one another and pushing and pulling each other throughout the story.

The pair function as the protagonists of Grand Theft Auto VI, with the player able to determine whether their relationship is platonic or romantic based on the Relationship System. The player can also switch which of the characters they are currently playing as, although some situations will require the player to play as Jason or Lucia.
sections.narrative: Jason wants an easy life, but things keep getting harder. His partnership with Lucia is at the center of the story.
sections.extras:
Influence
The relationship between Jason and Lucia Caminos has been compared to that of the real-life American criminals Bonnie and Clyde, due to their partnership in committing robberies. This is further evidenced with the game's November 19, 2026 release date coincides with the date reported for Bonnie Parker and Clyde Barrow's first bank robbery in 1932, tying into the Bonnie and Clyde influence.

Trivia
• Jason's last name may be derived from U.S. politician William Pope Duval, the first civilian governor of the Florida Territory from 1822 to 1834. Numerous locations and streets in Florida are named after Duval, notably Duval Street in Key West.

• According to Rockstar Games, Jason's circumstances contribute to his involvement in serious crime, including drug trafficking and bank robbery. The company intentionally leaves it ambiguous whether he is driven to crime by necessity or is naturally inclined toward it.

sections.story:
“The only thing that matters is who you know and what you got.”

Lucia Caminos is one of the two protagonists in Grand Theft Auto VI.

Lucia is the first major female protagonist in the Grand Theft Auto series to have a fully voiced role. She is often erroneously described as the first female protagonist in the series, as the first two games and Grand Theft Auto Online feature several female protagonists, although these characters are generally silent or optional.

Her voice actress has yet to be officially revealed.

“"Lucia’s father taught her to fight as soon as she could walk."
Life has been coming at her swinging ever since. Fighting for her family landed her in the Leonida Penitentiary. Sheer luck got her out. Lucia’s learned her lesson — only smart moves from here.

More than anything, Lucia wants the good life her mom has dreamed of since their days in Liberty City — but instead of half-baked fantasies, Lucia is prepared to take matters into her own hands.

A life with Jason could be her way out.
Fresh out of prison and ready to change the odds in her favor, Lucia’s committed to her plan — no matter what it takes.”

Lucia is a criminal who was incarcerated at the Leonida Penitentiary after fighting for her family. Her father taught her to fight from a young age, and she has since become determined to improve her circumstances and provide the better life her mother has dreamed of. She was born in Liberty City.

After being released from prison, Lucia becomes partners with Jason Duval. She sees a life with Jason as a possible way out and is committed to changing the odds in her favor.
sections.narrative: After getting out, Lucia is determined to build a better life, and she teams up with Jason.
sections.extras:
Influence
As per the context of the first trailer showing Lucia and Jason robbing various places across the State of Leonida, the duo appears to be inspired by the real-life American criminals Bonnie and Clyde, the former being also previously used as the inspiration for Catalina in the 3D Universe of the Grand Theft Auto series. This is further evidenced by the game's November 19, 2026 release date coincides with the date reported for Bonnie Parker and Clyde Barrow's first bank robbery in 1932, tying into the pair's Bonnie and Clyde influence.

Rockstar Games writer Alexa D'Agostino says that Lucia was inspired by people she knew, including her own mother, in a LOVE Magazine interview. She added that her mother raised her to be "rowdy, kind, but not to take any shit," which inspired Lucia's own personality in the game.

Trivia
• Lucia shares a few traits with Katie, one of the protagonists in the first Grand Theft Auto, who is also depicted as a Latina and has a crime record in Vice City from the 2D Universe canon, albeit she shares her crime record with the other protagonists.

• Lucia is the seventh female protagonist in the Grand Theft Auto series to date, along with Katie, Ulrika, Mikki, Divine, Candy, Gretchen and the GTA Online Protagonist. However, she is typically described as the first in the series, due to the fact the other protagonists are silent or optional.

• Lucia was raised in Liberty City.

• Lucia's character was partly inspired by the mother of Grand Theft Auto VI writer Alexa D'Agostino, who grew up in Newark, New Jersey.

“There are way too many birds flying around in perfect formation.”

Cal Hampton is a character due to appear in Grand Theft Auto VI.

Background

“"What if everything on the internet was true?"
Jason’s friend and a fellow associate of Brian’s, Cal feels safest hanging at home, snooping on Coast Guard comms with a few beers and some private browser tabs open.

"The psychopaths are in charge. Get used to it."
Cal is at the low tide of America and happy there. Casual paranoia loves company, but his friend Jason has bigger plans.”

“The club money pay for the studio, and the drug money pay for it all.”

Boobie Ike is a character due to appear in Grand Theft Auto VI.

Background

“"It's all about heart — the Jack of Hearts."
Boobie is a local Vice City legend — and acts like it. One of the few to transform his time in the streets into a legitimate empire spanning real estate, a strip club, and a recording studio — Boobie's all smiles until it's time to talk business.

"Top quality cuts."
Boobie might seem like he's just out for himself, but it's his partnership with the young aspiring music mogul Dre'Quan for Only Raw Records that he's most invested in — now they just need a hit.”

“Dancers are like my A&Rs. If the record's a hit, DJs gonna be spinnin' it.”

Dre'Quan Priest is a character due to appear in Grand Theft Auto VI.

Background

“"Only Raw... Records"
Dre'Quan was always more of a hustler than a gangster. Even when he was dealing on the streets to make ends meet, breaking into music was the goal.

"You're with the label now."
Now that he's signed the Real Dimez, Dre'Quan's days of booking acts into Boobie's strip club might be numbered as he sets his sights on the Vice City scene.”

“All my dimes in this club. Meet my twin, make it a dub.”

Real Dimez is a rap duo due to appear in Grand Theft Auto VI.

Background

“"Viral videos. Viral hooks."
Bae-Luxe and Roxy aka Real Dimez have been friends since high school — girls with the savvy to turn their time shaking down local dealers into cold, hard cash via spicy rap tracks and a relentless social media presence.

"One hit away from fame."
An early hit single with local rapper DWNPLY took Real Dimez to new heights. Now, after five years and a whole lot of trouble, they’re signed to Only Raw Records, hoping lightning can strike twice.”
sections.extras:
Influence
Real Dimez draws strong parallels with former Miami hip-hop duo City Girls, consisting of Yung Miami and JT. Both groups began their careers by leveraging social media to promote their music and gained mainstream popularity through high-profile collaborations: Real Dimez with fellow Vice City rapper DWNPLY on an unspecified hit single, and City Girls with Canadian rapper Drake on his 2018 hit single "In My Feelings". Notably, the City Girls' 2019 single "Act Up" is featured on the iFruit Radio station in Grand Theft Auto V and Online.

sections.story:
“Life is full of surprises, my friend. I think we'd all be wise to remember that.”

Raul Bautista is a character due to appear in Grand Theft Auto VI.

His voice actor is yet to be officially revealed.

Background

“"Experience counts."
Confidence, charm, and cunning — Raul’s a seasoned bank robber always on the hunt for talent ready to take the risks that bring the biggest rewards.

"A professional adapts."
Raul's recklessness raises the stakes with every score. Sooner or later, his crew will have to double down or pull their chips from the table.”

Raul Bautista serves as an older mentor to Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos, providing the criminal experience they lack when they arrive in Vice City. He introduces them to the large-scale heists and criminal operations that become part of their story. Rockstar Games also intended Raul to embody Vice City and its local criminal culture.

Extended Look

Raul is seen in Grand Theft Auto VI: An Extended Look when Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos pick him up while he is attempting to escape from the police. The pair help Raul escape the area, after which he tells them to "Keep their phone on," suggesting that Jason and Lucia are part of his crew.

“I hauled so much grass in that plane, I could make the state of Leonida levitate.”

Brian Heder is a character due to appear in Grand Theft Auto VI. He is voiced by Stephen Root.

Background

“"Nothing better than a Mudslide at sunset."
Brian's a classic drug runner from the golden age of smuggling in the Keys. Still moving product through his boat yard with his third wife, Lori, Brian's been around long enough to let others do his dirty work.

"Looks like a Leonida beach bum — moves like a great white shark."
Brian’s letting Jason live rent-free at one of his properties — so long as he helps with local shakedowns, and stops by for Lori’s sangria once in a while.”
